WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
shares AS (
  SELECT order_id, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS share
  FROM order_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_invoices,
  AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.a) AS avg_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.a;
